_why_curated: The OpenRouter API exposes NO faithfulness / hallucination metric (verified against /api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/:id/endpoints — neither carries one). The catalogue's Artificial-Analysis 'intelligence_index' is a general-capability proxy, not grounded-RAG faithfulness. So this short list is human-curated, not computed: it ranks models PM trusts for high-stakes, citation-critical chat by grounded-RAG faithfulness + instruction-following — the axes the API can't give us. The recommender ranks 'Advanced' PRIMARILY by the live intelligence_index and uses this list only as a faithfulness tie-break/bonus and as a fallback rank for models the benchmark doesn't cover. EDIT THIS as models change — every id here is matched against the live, ZDR-enforced catalogue, so a stale id simply drops out. See src/recommend.rs.
_verified: Every id below was confirmed present in the live catalogue on 2026-07-15. Presence is NOT sufficiency: PM pins zdr:true on every request, and OpenRouter now publishes the compliant set at /api/v1/endpoints/zdr — check an id against THAT before adding it, or the recommendation is one PM cannot call.
